text: dsh-shell-card-plus 是面向 DSH Web 的命令卡片界面插件，通过 tool.call.toolview 插槽接管 Bash 与 PowerShell 工具行，折叠时保留摘要行，展开后显示自定义终端卡片。卡片展示状态、工作目录末级名称、完整命令和执行输出；多行命令带行号并可自动换行，输出可横向滚动。用户可以分别复制命令和输出，失败、信号终止或工具错误时会显示对应状态提示。它适合希望在 DSH Web 中更清楚查看和复用终端命令的用户。插件使用已有调用数据进行展示，不增加 API 密钥或账号配置。

dsh-shell-card-plus customizes Bash and PowerShell rows in DSH Web. Expand a row to view status, working directory, wrapped commands with line numbers, and scrollable output. Separate buttons copy the command and output. Failures show status details. It uses existing call data and needs no API key.
想让 DSH Web 的 Bash 命令完整显示，不要长命令被截掉。
能不能在终端结果卡片上直接复制执行过的命令？
我想单独复制 shell 工具运行后的输出内容。
让 PowerShell 调用结果也显示成可展开的命令卡片。
我希望多行命令带行号，方便对照每一行内容。
DSH 的终端卡片能显示退出码或信号错误吗？
Can I copy a shell command directly from its result card?
I need long terminal commands to wrap with line numbers instead of getting cut off.
dsh-shell-card-plus 的「命令卡片」功能：接管 Bash 和 PowerShell 工具行，折叠时显示摘要，展开后查看终端卡片。点击工具行即可展开或收起。
dsh-shell-card-plus 的「复制命令与输出」功能：卡片提供两个独立按钮，分别把当前命令或输出写入剪贴板。命令为空或输出缺失时，相应按钮不可用。
dsh-shell-card-plus 的「命令与状态展示」功能：展开卡片可查看带行号的多行命令、工作目录名称和输出；执行失败、被信号终止或中断时显示相应状态。
dsh-shell-card-plus 的「非终端调用回退」功能：遇到后台任务确认、普通错误或截断结果等非终端调用时，保留原生通用工具行展示，不把它误当作终端输出卡片。

dsh-shell-card-plus README · 功能：- 完全替换官方 bash/pwsh 工具行：折叠行样式与官方一致，展开后是自定义卡片

  - **输出区**：横向滚动，保留原版阅读习惯

Enhanced command cards for bash / pwsh in the DSH web UI. Works out of the box; never touches how commands execute.

dsh-shell-card-plus README · What it fixes：The stock bash/pwsh card in DSH Web has two daily annoyances:

| Problem | Stock | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Long commands unreadable | Command is a single line, **truncated with an ellipsis** — anything past it is simply invisible | Command **soft-wraps** with line numbers, fully visible |
| No way to copy the command | Only a copy-output button exists; copying the command means manual text selection | Separate **copy command** and **copy output** buttons |

dsh-shell-card-plus README · What it fixes：Status display follows the official convention: quiet when normal (just a status dot), a red `exit N` / `Signal X` pill only on failure.


Left: stock expanded card · Right: this plugin's expanded card

dsh-shell-card-plus README · Features：- Fully replaces the official bash/pwsh tool row: the collapsed row keeps the official style; the expanded card is custom
  - **head**: status dot + cwd (subdirectory name) + copy-command / copy-output buttons
  - **command area**: full command, soft-wrapped with line numbers
  - **output area**: horizontal scroll, same reading habit as the original
- Only takes over bash/pwsh; other tools (read/write/search etc.) are untouched
dsh-shell-card-plus README · Install：```sh
dsh-shell-card-plus README · From npm (recommended — no allowBuilds setup needed)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-shell-card-plus
section: From npm (recommended — no allowBuilds setup needed)

dsh-shell-card-plus README · Or from a local directory：dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-shell-card-plus
```

Restart `dsh web` (or hard-refresh the browser, Ctrl+F5) after installing. Requires dsh ≥ 0.1.0-rc.5.

dsh-shell-card-plus README · How it works：Registers the `bash`/`pwsh` keys on the official `tool.call.toolview` slot to replace the official rendering of those tool rows. Command, cwd, output and exit status all come from the existing official ToolCallBlock data — the plugin is a pure presentation layer with no new events and no host changes. Implementation details: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md).

dsh-shell-card-plus README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build   # production build (lib/ is committed; users don't build)
npm run dev     # watch + hot reload
```

See [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) for development and handover docs.
